bullets.text: Built an event pipeline in Go handling 4.2M events a day with p99 under 120 ms.
Migrated 14 services to Kubernetes with a shared Helm chart, reducing deploys from 25 to 6 minutes.
Designed a gRPC integration kit, onboarding 11 carriers in 4 days instead of 3 weeks.
Shipped REST APIs in Django and PostgreSQL for 30+ client projects.
Wrote reconciliation jobs in Java that matched 2M card transactions nightly.
